description: CS2 skin price API: live prices, buy orders, and sales history for Counter-Strike 2 skins from Steam, Buff163, YouPin, CSFloat, Skinport and 40+ marketplaces, with price history since 2013, float, paint seed, phase and sticker data, and market analytics.
rules: Use https://api.cs2c.app/v1 for REST requests and load the Bearer API key from an environment variable.
Use provider keys such as buff163, csfloat, and youpin; check endpoint coverage before requesting a provider.
Repeat providers for multi-provider queries; /prices/history uses the singular provider parameter.
Interpret prices in the documented minor units and response currency; USD 2550 means $25.50.
Distinguish current asks, buy orders, completed sales, and historical ask snapshots.
Follow has_next and next_cursor on cursor endpoints; total=-1 is not a record count.
Respect endpoint tier requirements and Retry-After; use bounded retries for transient failures.
